pages.title: Recovery and Qi Condensing
pages.text: Spirit Recovery Pills rapidly restore spiritual power. Qi Condensing Pills grant cultivation and temporarily improve cultivation speed. Both are refined in an alchemy furnace from their respective formulas.

pages.title: Spirit Recovery Pill
pages.text: Restores a large amount of spiritual power after combat or repeated spellcasting.

pages.title: Qi Condensing Pill
pages.text: Grants cultivation and temporarily improves cultivation speed.
